text:
mia roberts: hey all - new hire here. unboxed an M2 Air and followed ABM + Kandji flow at home. enrollment shows 'Enrolled' but i'm stuck on two things: 1) enabling FileVault gives 'Escrow failed: proxy authentication required' and 2) corporate VPN installer says 'could not verify package - certificate chain incomplete'. i'm on a work-provided usb-c ethernet dongle that connects to a hotel ethernet (no wifi). anyone seen proxy issues with the dongles? who to ping?
it-ops: welcome! hotel+dongle combos can expose a transparent proxy that blocks SCEP/escrow. quick checks: run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo fdesetup status` and check Keychain Access -> Certificates for 'Redwood Corporate CA'. also do you see any captive portal in browser? don't paste full serials here; last 4 ok if needed.
daniel cho: also check System Settings -> Privacy & Security for 'System extension blocked' prompts. if proxy intercepts TLS, the cert won't install which breaks Okta/escrow. if you can tether to your phone or switch DNS to 1.1.1.1 it often helps.
mia roberts: ran checks:
profiles status -type enrollment: Enrolled to kandji: true; com.redwood.mdm present; com.redwood.security missing
sudo fdesetup status: FileVault is Off
Keychain: no Redwood CA
no captive portal popped up, ethernet goes straight through hotel switch. last 4 serial: E2B7
network-bot: automated hint: if a corporate CA is missing and you're behind a proxy, try visiting https://kandji.redwood/setup-cert in Safari to force a cert install. if proxy requires auth, the hotel switch may be doing TLS interception.
it-ops: thanks - two paths: 1) if you can tether to phone or find an unproxied network, visit the Kandji URL and then run `profiles renew -type enrollment` and `sudo fdesetup enable`; or 2) request a remote remediation: we can push com.redwood.security via Kandji (need last 4 serial, which you provided) and open a temporary admin window so you can approve system extensions and run FileVault manually while we monitor. which do you prefer?
mia roberts: i'm stuck at airport for a few hours, can't tether reliably. prefer remote remediate + temp admin.
it-ops: ok granting 2-hour temp admin and pushing remediation now. creating ticket NH-20260430-21 and tagging endpoint/network. please keep the device online and don't disconnect the dongle until we confirm.
network-bot: remediation: push_profile(com.redwood.security) -> queued -> delivered to device (status: pending user action)
daniel cho: you'll get a Kandji action to accept profile; after accepting check Keychain for the CA, then approve any system extension banners and run `sudo fdesetup enable`. if FileVault still errors with proxy auth, we'll perform a portal-based manual escrow which records the recovery key.
mia roberts: approved Kandji action, saw 'Redwood Corporate CA' in Keychain, approved two system extension prompts. ran `sudo fdesetup enable` and it showed 'Escrow in progress' then reported success. Okta changed to compliant after a refresh. VPN installer now verifies correctly. thanks team! :tada:
